from pathlib import Path
import base64,hashlib,io,json,tarfile,urllib.request
root=Path.cwd();target=root/'dist/wfz-release/reveal-5.2.1';target.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
url='https://registry.npmjs.org/reveal.js/-/reveal.js-5.2.1.tgz';expected='r7//6mIM5p34hFiDMvYfXgyjXqGRta+/psd9YtytsgRlrpRzFv4RbH76TXd2qD+7ZPZEbpBDhdRhJaFgfQ7zNQ=='
with urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request(url,headers={'User-Agent':'DuckRabbit-render-proof'}),timeout=30) as response:data=response.read(16*1024*1024+1)
assert len(data)<=16*1024*1024 and base64.b64encode(hashlib.sha512(data).digest()).decode()==expected
with tarfile.open(fileobj=io.BytesIO(data),mode='r:gz') as archive:
 members=archive.getmembers();assert len(members)<500 and sum(m.size for m in members)<16*1024*1024
 assert all(m.isfile() or m.isdir() for m in members)
 archive.extractall(target,filter='data')
metadata=json.loads((target/'package/package.json').read_text());assert metadata['name']=='reveal.js' and metadata['version']=='5.2.1'
record={'version':'5.2.1','url':url,'archive_sha256':hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),'npm_sha512':expected,'unpacked_bytes':sum(m.size for m in members),'files':{p.relative_to(target/'package').as_posix():hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in (target/'package').rglob('*') if p.is_file()},'installation':'Prebuilt assets extracted only; no npm install or lifecycle scripts'}
(root/'dist/wfz-release/receipts/reveal-runtime.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in record.items() if k!='files'}))
